Paper filing is still an option for Form 1040-X. File Form 1040-X to: Correct Form 1040, 1040-SR, or 1040-NR (or older filings of Form 1040-A or 1040-EZ). Make certain elections after the deadline. Change amounts previously adjusted by the IRS. Make a claim for a carryback due to a loss or unused credit.
